title: Sigurnost objekata i životni ciklus sistema
summary: Dizajn lokacije i objekta (slojevi, CPTED), kontrole za IDF, data centre, skladišta medija i dokaza, HVAC, požar i napajanje, te upravljanje životnim ciklusom sistema od zahtjeva do sigurnog povlačenja uz kontinuirani security review.
title_en: Site and Facility Security and the System Life Cycle
summary_en: Site and facility design (layers, CPTED), controls for wiring closets/IDFs, data centers, media and evidence storage, HVAC, fire and power, and system life cycle management from requirements to secure decommissioning with continuous security review.
